title: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is launching a new Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT that allows the chatbot to answer your questions with interactive visuals. The update, which is rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6, gives ChatGPT the ability to combine a text response with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons, and more. In a blog post explaining the change , OpenAI says it trained GPT-6 when to generate interactive visuals over text, as well as how to format them in its response. An example shared by OpenAI shows how ChatGPT might show a diagram of a seven-speed bicycle if you ask about its design, complete with interactive buttons that highlight differe … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI 随 GPT-6 一同推出 ChatGPT「Intelligent UI」更新，聊天机器人不再只回文字，而是能生成图表、示意图、表单和可点击按钮等交互式视觉内容。OpenAI 表示专门训练 GPT-6 判断何时该用视觉而非文字作答，并已向所有用户推送。这标志着对话式 AI 从纯文本界面转向富交互界面，可能重塑用户与 AI 的交互范式，也是 GPT-6 发布中最具产品差异化的部分。

title: Claude新模型发布！跑分暴击GPT-6 Luna，价格比梁文谷还便宜，OpenAI只能送重置卡挽尊
summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude 新模型，在跑分上大幅超越 GPT-6 Luna，且定价低于 DeepSeek 系列，被量子位称为「小模型新守门员」。报道称 OpenAI 只能靠赠送重置卡挽回用户。若属实，这将是开源/低价模型阵营对闭源头部的一次正面冲击，也说明小尺寸模型在性价比维度上的竞争已进入白热化，值得关注其对 API 定价体系的连锁影响。

title: Mistral Large 4
raw_excerpt: Mistral Large 4 is a one-trillion-parameter multimodal model positioned as a European alternative to leading closed and open AI systems.
summary: Mistral 发布 Mistral Large 4，一款万亿参数多模态模型，明确将自己定位为欧洲对标的领先闭源与开源 AI 系统的替代方案。这是欧洲主权 AI 阵营在超大参数规模上的一次重要补位，也意味着全球前沿模型竞赛中欧洲厂商仍在持续加注，对关注模型地缘格局与开源生态的读者具有参考价值。

title: Claude Haiku 5.5
summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，在 Hacker News 上以 849 分、413 条评论登顶当日热榜，是过去 24 小时讨论度最高的模型发布之一。Haiku 系列一向主打低延迟与低成本，此次迭代预计进一步压低轻量级推理价格，对高频调用、端侧和 Agent 场景影响直接，也加剧了与 GPT-6 系列在性价比区间的竞争。

title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
raw_excerpt: OpenAI has released a broad range of mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model. It has published the results in a GitHub repository along with protocols for paper revisions and citations. The repository contains formalizations of many of the proofs in Lean and will be updated with more formalizations as they are obtained. It also includes 10 summaries of the model's reasoning, estimations of compute spent in terms of Pro usage on ChatGPT, and statistics about the number of attempted problems.
summary: OpenAI 公开了一批由内部前沿模型产出的数学成果，发布在 GitHub 仓库中，并附上论文修订与引用协议、Lean 形式化证明、10 份模型推理摘要以及按 ChatGPT Pro 用量估算的算力消耗统计。这是 AI 首次成规模地对外输出可验证的新数学结果，引发数学界震动，也把「AI 能否做原创研究」的争论推向实证层面。

title: Google invests millions in Mark Zuckerberg’s efforts to create a ‘virtual cell’
raw_excerpt: Google DeepMind, Meta, and AI drug discovery startup Isomorphic Labs are jointly investing $300 million into an initiative to create a "virtual cell" that researchers can use to combat disease, as reported earlier by Reuters . The project is led by Biohub, a nonprofit biomedical research organization founded by Mark Zuckerberg and his wife, Priscilla Chan. It comes as part of a $1.8 billion "Virtual Biology" initiative to build AI datasets that could allow researchers to "ask, predict, and answer biological questions digitally." Founded in 2016 , Biohub aims to prevent and cure diseases through the creation of a "high-accuracy predictive mode … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Google DeepMind、Meta 与 AI 制药公司 Isomorphic Labs 联合向 Biohub 投资 3 亿美元，用于构建可供研究者对抗疾病的「虚拟细胞」，属于总额 18 亿美元「Virtual Biology」计划的一部分。Biohub 由扎克伯格夫妇创立。该项目意在用 AI 数据集让研究者能数字化地提问、预测和回答生物学问题，是 AI for Science 领域迄今规模最大的跨界合作之一。

title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
raw_excerpt: At today's Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed off an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that will give it access to local files on your PC and the ability to take actions across the OS. It's part of an idea Microsoft is calling "Hybrid Intelligence," where apps and tools rely on a mix of local and cloud AI models to accomplish tasks efficiently. To show off how Hybrid Intelligence works, Jacob Andreou, Microsoft's EVP of Copilot, walked through a video demo onstage asking Microsoft's Autopilot tool to help with filing taxes. Andreou told the AI agent that he got an email from his accountant and asked Autopilot to get her what she nee … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 微软在 Windows 与 Surface 发布会上展示 Copilot 升级：可访问本地文件并跨操作系统执行操作，微软称之为「Hybrid Intelligence」，即本地与云端模型混合完成任务。现场演示中，Copilot 的 Autopilot 工具被要求协助报税，能读取账户邮件并推进流程。这意味着 AI 助手正从问答走向真正接管操作系统与个人数据，权限与隐私边界将成为后续焦点。

title: A $12B DeepSeek Raise Is Reportedly Close, With Tencent And CATL Among Backers
raw_excerpt: DeepSeek is nearing a $12 billion raise, surpassing its initial 50 billion yuan target, with Tencent and CATL as major contributors. The funding boost follows the release of DeepSeek's latest AI model, with expectations it might reach 100 billion yuan. The company is also preparing for a potential Shanghai STAR Market IPO, employing CITIC Securities for assistance.
summary: 据报道，DeepSeek 接近完成 120 亿美元融资，超出最初 500 亿元人民币目标，腾讯与宁德时代为主要出资方，并可能冲击 1000 亿元规模。公司还在筹备上海科创板 IPO，已聘请中信证券协助。若落地，这将是全球 AI 领域规模最大的单轮融资之一，也显示中国大模型厂商在资本层面正加速集结，对算力与人才争夺格局影响深远。

title: EmbeddingGemma 2
raw_excerpt: EmbeddingGemma 2 is a 740M-parameter model that maps text, code, images, audio, and video into a shared embedding space. Built for on-device inference and released under Apache 2.0, it enables multimodal search and retrieval without sending data to the cloud.
summary: Google 发布 EmbeddingGemma 2，一个 7.4 亿参数模型，可将文本、代码、图像、音频和视频映射到统一嵌入空间，专为端侧推理设计并以 Apache 2.0 许可开源。它让多模态搜索与检索无需把数据上传云端即可完成，对隐私敏感场景和离线应用意义重大，也进一步巩固 Gemma 系列在开放端侧模型生态中的位置。

title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
raw_excerpt: The Personal Agent Protocol is an open standard that Meta and Sierra are developing along with other industry partners. It is designed to handle authentication, empower consumers, and give companies visibility into what personal agents do through their websites, APIs, or company agents. Consumers decide what access to give their personal agents, and companies set parameters for what those agents can do. The protocol is open for anyone to implement.
summary: Meta 与 Sierra 联合多家行业伙伴推出开放标准「Personal Agent Protocol」，用于处理个人 AI 代理的身份认证，让消费者自主决定授予代理何种访问权限，同时让企业设定代理在其网站、API 或企业代理中可执行的操作范围。该协议开放给任何人实现。随着个人代理开始代用户下单、办事，这一协议试图解决代理与网站之间的信任与授权空白，可能成为 Agent 生态的关键基础设施。
